_README: Public default connector template — applied at first onboarding when no enterprise key is registered. Fill in your own server URLs in each connector's base_url; the ${...} placeholders are prompted for once and reused everywhere. Existing non-empty values in your installed config are NEVER overwritten by re-importing.

github_pat.label: GitHub Personal Access Token (optional)
github_pat.hint: Only needed for private repos or higher rate limits. Generate at: github.com/settings/tokens

jenkins_username.label: Jenkins username (optional)
jenkins_username.hint: Your Jenkins login. Leave blank if you're not using Jenkins.

jenkins_api_token.label: Jenkins API Token (optional)
jenkins_api_token.hint: User avatar → Configure → API Token → Add new

blackduck_api_token.label: Black Duck API Token (optional)
blackduck_api_token.hint: User menu → My Access Tokens → Create new. Only needed if you use Black Duck.
